primary: Select the lower count of severe move errors under shared teacher budgets on the same 512 validation positions.
tie_break: If severe counts tie, select lower mean regret on the common finite-CP subset; if both tie, retain the earlier checkpoint.
secondary: Report paired uncertainty, strata and development games alongside this point-estimate selection. A small sample winner is not proof of general superiority.
history: Include already evaluated B8M as a historical reference when harmonizing validation budgets; final selection is between the retained B16M candidate and the final B26M stage.
validation_reuse: Validation was already used for A/B pilot and 8M-to-16M review; this is selection data, not a new independent confirmation.
final_test: Freeze the chosen checkpoint and hash before a single sealed test evaluation of 512 positions and 64 paired games against historical v6. Do not change selection after test results.
inference: PUCT64, c_puct1.5; source-game clustered game uncertainty; all legal promotions.
finalization: Run known regressions at 64/256, export the selected model with parity checks, retain full resumable checkpoints, release temporary sleep inhibitor, finish report. No automatic training beyond 26,000,128.
